searchText: I hope it's the right channel for the question I have the issue with consensus tests: I don't understand this test format https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/dev/tests/formats/kzg_7594/recover_cells_and_kzg_proofs.md first of all it includes `proofs` which are not included in format description and second, there are tests which should fail because of these proofs but I don't understand how could I check this without commitments Hey <@425907307621122049> thanks for pointing this out. The sentence at the top is out of date. It only takes cells now, not cells & proofs. But the format itself is correct. It looks like the consensus-spec tests haven't been updated for a while (over a month) and no longer match the spec. The new spec tests do not include proofs. For example: https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/233129122bd289316f9aa5afbeefa25392618aa5/tests/generators/kzg_7594/main.py#L528-L534 so format description is correct I don't need to try to fix my runner for alpha.3 updated tests (alpha.4 or whatever) will be good Agreed. Tag <@415109946682769408>.
